Hi Olivia / Marcus,

Thanks again for confirming the room block for our executive workshop on Aug 30–31. Before we lock rates and distribute the rooming sheet, I want to align on the guest check-in experience and how the hotel will capture negotiated rates so our finance team can reconcile quickly. High-level asks below — see the attached rooming_template_v3.xlsx and northbridge_rate_sheet_Aug2026.pdf for details.

Key requests: 
- Master room block name: Redwood Inference — please ensure the group rate code appears on folios.
- Check-in flow: can the front desk pre-print keycards and have a dedicated group lane? What's the expected wait time during our 3:00–6:00pm arrival window?
- Early arrivals: we expect ~15% early check-ins (arrivals between 11am–2pm). Can you hold 8 rooms for guaranteed early check-ins or provide luggage storage and a 10% early-arrival rate?
- Rate capture: define the folio code / rate plan name exactly (we need it in the invoice).
- Keycard distribution for split arrivals: can we have keycards pre-assigned to attendee last names from the rooming template? If not, what's the quickest on-site workaround (e.g., will the concierge bring packets to the meeting space)?
- Breakfast vouchers: group continental breakfast included for booked room nights? Need voucher or billing code.

Please confirm items above and note any constraints by end of day Friday so I can share the final plan with the exec team.

Thanks,

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the clear list — all good questions. Quick answers below and details follow in the attached keycard-instructions.docx and our internal group SOP.

- Group name / rate plan: "Redwood Inference — Executive Workshop"; rate code RIDX-AUG26. We will ensure the code is on each folio and on the master invoice.
- Dedicated lane: yes, we'll staff a dedicated group lane at the front desk from 2:30–6:30pm. Estimated peak wait time 3–6 minutes per check-in when staffed.
- Pre-printing keycards: we can pre-print keycards and place them in sealed packets behind the group desk if we have a final rooming list 72 hours prior. For split arrivals, concierge can deliver packets to the meeting room within 20 minutes.
- Early arrivals: we can hold 8 rooms for guaranteed early check-ins (first-come, first-served) and provide luggage storage with priority retrieval. Early-arrival fee can be waived for these holds.
- Breakfast: continental breakfast is included for roomed nights under the group rate; we will provide breakfast vouchers for walk-in breakfasts at the cafe — we'll add the voucher code to the folio.
- Billing and folios: we will post the negotiated rate to each guest folio and include the RIDX-AUG26 rate code so finance can reconcile. Master folio will be produced daily if you prefer.

Please send the completed rooming spreadsheet by 2026-08-27 17:00 PDT to guarantee pre-printed keycards. If you'd like, Marcus can coordinate on the logistics side.
